frontier.hypothesis: The 74<->97 expand_preferences pairing can be obtained WITHOUT routing a value through allocno 74, which would leave the sum of squares in $a0 and close the function at 0.
frontier.mechanism: v3/v4/v5 all create the REG_DEAD(74) note on an a0_var-defining insn by making `threshold` CARRY a real value, and the carried value then occupies 74's own argument register $a2 -- that IS v5's remaining 2-insn residual. expand_preferences only needs a single_set to 97 whose REG_NOTES mention 74; it does not require 74's value to be an operand of the result. Any construct that makes threshold's LAST USE land on the insn defining a0_var, rather than on the 4th range test, satisfies the pass without displacing a register.
